mechanism_narrative: The sustained decline in RETAIL_REC from -8.6% to -9.3% over the past four weeks indicates a persistent negative trend in consumer discretionary spending and out-of-home activities, which is likely to continue, leading to further decreases in retail and recreation mobility.
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days (-8.875%).

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days does not decrease relative to the previous 14 days, despite WORKPLACES falling by more than 10 percentage points week-on-week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days, even when RESIDENTIAL mobility is consistently above 10% and WORKPLACES mobility is consistently below -10%.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 7 days, despite PARKS mobility increasing by more than 5 percentage points week-on-week.
